title: Universal frontmatter fields of a _concept/ markdown file
description: The fields every markdown file in _concept/ carries (tree/README.md § Frontmatter every markdown artifact carries). Per-artifact fields are open: each artifact's own section names them. approved is written by the skill that holds the approval step, in the same write that records the user's yes; a pending file carries no approved key rather than an empty one. Dates: validate after turning YAML dates into ISO text, per tree/README.md § Frontmatter every markdown artifact carries.

approved.description: The date the user approved this artifact; absent means not yet approved. A later edit that changes the substance clears it.
